title: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR
text: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR. You get what you pay for. Very cheaply made product. Had a few of the metal folding locks break and take a chunk of the frame with it. They're still usable and they were very inexpensive, so cant complain too much. If you're looking for "nice" frames, these are not the ones for you.
